items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: The interesting thing about New York jazz, though, was look at the pianists that came from New York -- Fats Waller, J.P. Johnson, Willie 'the Lion' Smith

ctx.x: Well, I don't know. The interesting thing about New York jazz, though, was look at the pianists that came from New York -- Fats Waller, J.P. Johnson, Willie 'the Lion' Smith, you know, from Newark, originally, but he really came up in New York, I think.
